_nota: Inglés de `countermeasures_research.json` (`core/i18n.py`): castellano exacto → inglés, valor entero por valor entero. El fichero castellano no se toca; las claves, los ids y las frases literales de una fuente no se traducen. Lo aplica `i18n.localized` al servir.

strings.El PDF de 12 páginas en nasa.gov, recorr: The 12-page PDF on nasa.gov, searched in full as text for «virtual», «cuff», «negative pressure», «artificial gravity» and «centrifug»; the paragraphs on pages 6 (isolation and confinement), 9 and 10 (gravity fields) were read.
strings.El PDF de 109 páginas, recorrido entero: The 109-page PDF, searched in full as text for «negative pressure», «LBNP», «thigh cuff», «Braslet», «artificial gravity» and «centrifug»; the paragraph on page 24 (§V) and the conclusions on pages 84 and 85 (§VII, «Conclusions and Forward Work») were read.
strings.La página de divulgación de AGBRESA en n: The AGBRESA outreach page on nasa.gov: the paragraphs on centrifugation and its purpose.
strings.El artículo de resultados de AGBRESA sob: The AGBRESA results article on physical capacity, read in full in the Europe PMC full text: abstract, methods, results, discussion and conclusion.
strings.El estado de ánimo de una tripulación ai: The mood of an isolated crew.
strings.La fuente dice que se está estudiando; n: The source says it is being studied; it does not say that it is used in flight nor with what equipment.
strings.El desplazamiento de fluidos hacia la ca: The headward fluid shift, which the SANS report relates to the ocular changes of flight.
strings.NASA (2022) los describe en presente, si: NASA (2022) describes them in the present tense, without naming a model; the 2017 evidence report counts the Braslet among the devices under study as a SANS countermeasure.
strings.Ninguna de las fuentes leídas dice qué t: None of the sources read says which crews wear them today, nor whether any test has shown them to work against SANS.
strings.El desplazamiento de fluidos hacia la ca: The headward fluid shift: moving fluids from the head to the legs.
strings.En estudio como contramedida del SANS se: Under study as a SANS countermeasure according to the 2017 evidence report.
strings.El informe cita un editorial (Bogomolov: The report cites an editorial (Bogomolov et al. 2015) that counts the Russian Chibis device among the cosmonauts' countermeasures and puts forward that it might protect them; that is what the editorial puts forward, not a result. NASA (2022) says that it «could help».
strings.Los cambios fisiológicos de la ingravide: The physiological changes of weightlessness; for the SANS report, also the headward fluid shift.
strings.Estudiada en Tierra, en reposo en cama (: Studied on Earth, in bed rest (AGBRESA): in its results article, 30 minutes a day did not maintain aerobic capacity and attenuated part of the loss of muscle function. NASA presents it as a possible future countermeasure.
strings.La página de AGBRESA dice «may one day b: The AGBRESA page says «may one day be a countermeasure»: it is not a flight countermeasure today according to that source. The results article on physical capacity (Kramer et al. 2021) concludes that, on its own, it is not enough: it would have to be combined with exercise before it could be considered a comprehensive countermeasure. Nothing was read about the result in the other areas of the study.
strings.Eur J Appl Physiol 2021, «Discussion», p: Eur J Appl Physiol 2021, «Discussion», first paragraph
strings.Versión modificada del sistema Kaatsu: Modified version of the Kaatsu system
strings.Redistribuir los fluidos en sentido dist: Redistributing fluids distally («distally», in the sentence of the SANS report).
strings.El informe solo lo nombra en esa lista:: The report only names it in that list: it does not say what the modification is, who uses it, or with what result. EMMA has nothing more on it.
The report only names it in that list: it does not say how it would be used or with what result. EMMA has nothing more on it.
strings.Ninguna de las fuentes leídas da, para e: None of the sources read gives, for these countermeasures, crew time, resources, contraindications, adverse effects or a follow-up window: that is why they do not have those fields, which the library requires of its entries.
strings.El informe del SANS es de 2017 y dice «c: The SANS report is from 2017 and says «currently underway»: whatever has been learned after that date is not in what was read, and today's status may be different.
strings.Del resultado publicado de AGBRESA se le: Of the published AGBRESA results, the article on physical capacity was read (Kramer et al. 2021). Two web searches (2026-10-26) also returned the one on the cardiorespiratory and neuromuscular demand of centrifugation (Kramer et al. 2020, Front Physiol), which was not read, and no article with the result of the whole study; those of the other areas (orthostatic tolerance, SANS, bone) were not searched for one by one.
strings.«Software-generated workout partners» (N: «Software-generated workout partners» (NASA 2022, p. 10): they motivate exercise, which the library already has as a countermeasure; they are not a separate countermeasure.
strings.«Virtual assistants» (NASA 2022, p. 8):: «Virtual assistants» (NASA 2022, p. 8): they help to recognize and respond to anomalies; they are a decision-support tool, not a countermeasure on the person.
